title: Soul Eater: Plot of Medusa — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Nihilism is not the conclusion of Soul Eater: Plot of Medusa — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. Soul Eater (Japanese: ソウルイーター, Hepburn: Sōru Ītā) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Atsushi Ohkubo. Set at the "Death Weapon Meister Academy", the series revolves around three teams, each consisting of a weapon meister and at least one human that can transform into a weapon.

The psychology underneath Soul Eater: Plot of Medusa is simpler and older than the story on top. It later aired on Adult Swim's Toonami programming block from February 17, 2013, to March 16, 2014. Six pieces of theme music are used for the episodes: two opening themes and four ending themes.
